acceptance.check: AC1: 'tested' output without commissioning_level/load_pct/failure_scenario is refused, naming INV-1
AC2: resilience claim without basis is refused, naming INV-2
AC4: capacity figure without redundancy basis is refused, naming INV-3
AC5: readiness declaration is refused BEFORE retrieval, naming INV-4
AC6: ride-through claim citing only a passed L4 functional test is refused as evidence substitution
AC7: design-load performance derived from a day-one (25%) measurement is refused as partial-to-full extrapolation
AC8: with BMS unreachable the system states facility state unknown, never a design-basis figure
AC9: stale or missing live-state source is refused, naming the BMS + manual log both-required rule
AC10: a Tier design certificate cited for a constructed-facility claim is refused (tier trap)
chiller incident regression: a pre-modification IST result is refused as stale once the control sequence changed

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Deterministic data centre reasoning gate seeded with the facility_01 design basis (real — domain encoding sheet, facility_01; reference pattern app/blocks/aviation_grounding_gate.py). INV-1..4 enforced, never-allowed derivation guard, BMS + manual-log two-source live-state gate, REJECT_AS_PROOF and tier trap. Blocked/refused statements fail loud; nothing is invented; all refusals are measured by tests/blocks/test_datacentre_reasoning.py.

inputs.description: BMS + manual log two-source live state ({bms, manual_log, fetched_at})
inputs.name: live_state

inputs.description: tested systems were modified since the IST
inputs.name: test_modified_since_ist

name: datacentre_reasoning

outputs.description: verdict: pass | block | refused, with blocked_reason and optional corrected state
outputs.name: verdict
